item.title: Satisfyer Pro 2 Generation 3
item.description: The Satisfyer Pro 2 is the product that made pressure-wave stimulation a mass-market category rather than a luxury one. This review covers the Pro 2 Generation 3, verified 2026-10-12; Satisfyer also sells Generation 2 and a Generation 4 Connect App alongside it. It is best understood as the accessible entry point into air-pulse toys: it delivers the same basic contactless clitoral sensation as devices costing several times more, with a shorter feature list and a less refined interface.
